landmarks.name: tiers of seats rising all around the hall, full of a varied crowd
the standing ring around the top of the hall, crowded behind a railing
the broad walkway spanning the hall high above the floor, with a railing on each side
a few slim, light hologram towers on small gliding bases, drifting across the floor, glowing cube clusters on top
the whole play space alive with glowing holograms: gliders streaking past with light trails, little ships and walls of light cubes in cyan and amber
Deluin's sunken pit at the edge of the floor

two big screens hung over the hall, showing the two players' faces
